window-1.title: laurel.world — Laurel Schwulst's site
window-1.blurb: It's less a portfolio than a soft cream-colored room you wander through, where every project links sideways to another by year, medium, or friend — the kind of hand-made web object that'll make you want to rebuild your own site by midnight.

window-2.title: ★ july newsletter ★ — film friends
window-2.blurb: It's a scrappy little film-photography newsletter that reads like a group chat of people who all shoot on expired stock and actually finish their rolls — grainy, warm, and exactly the kind of thing that'll have you digging out the point-and-shoot by Saturday.

window-3.title: Lychee Mocktail With Rose
window-3.blurb: Canned lychee syrup, rosewater and lime in a glass — it's basically a childhood dessert-stall memory turned into a drink, and that shameless pink is going to photograph beautifully on film.

window-4.title: The Modern House — Journal
window-4.blurb: Every home in here treats a lifetime of accumulated stuff as the actual decor — books on the floor, one perfect lamp, zero styling — which is permission to let all your side-quest objects live out in the open instead of in bins.

window-5.title: Dona Manis Heritage Bakehouse, Katong
window-5.blurb: The 30-year-old basement banana pie legend finally got a sit-down room in Katong — and it doubles as a stop on a city-wide Monopoly heritage trail, so your pastry run comes with a built-in side quest.
